settings.description: Map of sysctl key-value pairs (keys must be valid sysctl param names; values are strings/numbers/booleans, auto-converted to appropriate representation). Use `settings` as a dictionary for flexibility, but common keys include `fs.file-max`, `vm.swappiness`, etc. For this specific service, we focus on file descriptor limits.

default.comment: Common production-safe default for high-load systems

fs.file-max.description: Maximum number of file handles the kernel will allocate system-wide

default.comment: Production-sane lower swappiness to reduce swapping on servers

vm.swappiness.description: Tendency of the kernel to swap memory pages (0-100). Lower values reduce swapping.

fs.inotify.max_user_instances.description: Maximum number of inotify instances per user (increase for services like file watchers, Docker, etc.)

fs.inotify.max_user_watches.description: Maximum number of inotify watches per user
